title: MemberService.register
description: Parses the name and email, refuses a taken email and inserts the member, in one transaction. It publishes `MemberRegistered` once its transaction commits.

title: ToolService.add
description: Parses the name, trims the description and inserts the tool in good condition. It publishes `ToolAdded` once its transaction commits.

title: ToolService.reportDamage
description: Parses the note and sets the tool to needs repair in one transaction, leaving any loan alone. It publishes `DamageReported` once its transaction commits. The librarian's endpoint and the event handler TL-LEND-PO01-H both invoke it.

title: ToolService.markRepaired
description: Refuses a tool that does not need repair, then sets it to good and clears the note, in one transaction. It publishes `ToolRepaired` once its transaction commits.

title: LendingService.borrow
description: Runs the checks in order in one transaction and inserts the loan with its due date. It publishes `LoanOpened` once its transaction commits.

title: LendingService.return
description: Requires a valid condition, refuses a second return, records the return and reports whether it was late, in one transaction that touches only the loan. It publishes `ToolReturned` once its transaction commits.
